votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of November 14, 2023; December 12, 2023; and January 9, 2024.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from three prior RDA meetings. This is a routine administrative action to formally adopt the meeting record.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, disposition, or acquisition of real property, and for attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137.
votes.description: The Board voted to move into a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters. This is a standard procedural motion to allow confidential deliberations.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open meeting. The session had covered real property strategy and attorney-client matters.
